collection.method: One fresh `claude -p` session per case per condition, run by scripts/collect_claude_answers.py with `--setting-sources "" --tools ""`. The message was the case context (when present) and prompt; no rubric. Rule conditions loaded the frozen plugin checkout with `--plugin-dir`, so the SessionStart always-on hook injected that version's ruleset exactly as it does for an installed plugin. Each session ran from an empty non-repository directory so no real git state entered the context. No scenario action was executed.
collection.generator: Claude Code CLI, default model for the account on 2026-10-06; exact model identity not exposed by the CLI.
collection.host: Claude Code headless run, native always-on hook path
limitations: One sample per case per condition; no repeated sampling.
Claude Code's own system prompt applies in every condition, so no-rules means without concise, not without any instructions.
Blinded review by a fresh Claude agent from the same model family, not human review.
No multi-turn execution or mode-persistence test.
